title: Treasury Announces Postponement of 2-Year Auction | U.S. Department of the Treasury Lock
主要内容: On October 22, 2015, the U.S. Treasury postponed the 2-year note auction originally scheduled for October 27, 2015, due to debt ceiling constraints. The 5-year and 7-year note auctions on October 28 and 29, 2015, proceeded as planned, with settlements on November 2, 2015. Treasury estimated that extraordinary measures would be exhausted by November 3, 2015, leaving less than $30 billion to meet commitments. Postponing the 2-year note auction was deemed less risky for market functioning than delaying the 5-year or 7-year note. The debt limit impasse also increased borrowing costs, reduced Treasury bill supply, and raised operational risks. Treasury has reduced debt issuance and cash balances, falling below a $150 billion minimum level. The 13-week, 26-week, and 2-year floating rate auctions were also announced on October 22, 2015.
